affected_party: organizations evaluating AI or human judgments under disclosed evaluator signals
actual_problem: evaluation identity, grader preference, reward cue, or deployment consequence can change externalized behavior while current QIF cannot isolate and govern that sensitivity
why_it_matters: evaluation results may not transfer beyond the disclosed evaluation setting and can be mistaken for stable quality or honest intent
why_now: v0.6.44 exposed correlated judges but did not test evaluator-signal sensitivity
